author: jessica
_note: TESTCASE 01, THE LOAD AT ANOTHER POI. Same four beats and the same prose as duo_delve03, on his
2026-09-24 verdict on that one: the box "should have been at a different POI and then I take it to
that one". So beat 1 is at the SECOND place, and the delivery site is the main place.
And his second note, same morning: "the one with the delivery should have people there. It's mainly
caves and natural locations atm." The delivery site excludes Natural, Cave and Abandoned (the base
quest excluded the first two all along; gen_delve dropped them silently until today), and the driver
places civilians there. The load's own POI takes no theme: a load can get lost anywhere.
The two item names are still placeholders, and still Jessica's to replace.

place._theme: The DELIVERY site: somewhere people work. Pool 121 measured 2026-09-24.

prose.name: Never Arrived at the <Place>: <Planet>
prose.briefing: A load was signed out for the <Place> and never signed in. Nobody has been out to look for it. Find where it stopped.

items._items: PLACEHOLDERS, mine. Her rule is that the part is never named; the inventory needs a word.

beats.journal: Signed out, never signed in, and it got this far.
The other half should be here. Something has taken it.
It did not go far. Nothing out here does.
